description: A compound–adverse drug reaction relationship reported in regulatory drug package insert labels and supplied by SIDER. Side effects use MedDRA-normalized UMLS concepts. Coverage includes preferred terms, lowest level terms and broad MedDRA grouping categories. Only compounds represented in SPOKE are included; each compound–side effect pair has one relationship.

common_properties.name: meddra_type
common_properties.description: MedDRA hierarchy level for the relationship: preferred term, lowest level term, or an empty string for broad grouping categories. Where a pair has support at several levels, the value favors preferred term over lowest level term, and lowest level term over an empty string.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the compound–side effect relationship.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when the relationship was created or its properties changed.

source_contributions.scope: Adverse drug reactions extracted from drug package insert labels, including all documented MedDRA concept levels. Relationships without a represented Compound or a required compound identifier, normalized UMLS identifier or side effect name are excluded.
source_contributions.description: SIDER provides regulatory-label compound–side effect associations. Side effect identity is the MedDRA-normalized UMLS concept rather than the raw label-extracted concept.
